mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; duloxetine inhibits serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake while phenelzine irreversibly inhibits monoamine oxidase, creating severe risk of serotonin syndrome.
action: Contraindicated combination - do not use together; ensure minimum 14-day washout from phenelzine before starting duloxetine, or 5 days from duloxetine before starting phenelzine.
